## Boundary
Only listed IDs and adjacent blank lines may change. Paths begin `tests/unit/`. `D[owner]`=leading string; `C[scope>next]`=maximal full-line region; `<previous>` is a disambiguating preceding-code anchor. Prefix with `tests/unit/<file>#D:` or `#C:<scope>:before:` and, when shown, `:after:`. Each resolves once.

Oracle retains three blobs; parses with `type_comments=True`; strips only allowlisted leading docstrings from current/final copies; normalizes only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; requires equal residual ASTs. Targets stay nonempty and shorter; tokens protect inline/unlisted comments. Current/final directive text+attachment (0) and shebangs (zero) stay exact.

## Protection / contracts / consumers
Protect every unlisted docstring/comment and every inline comment, including provider-parity schema/projection helpers, short strict-push controls, and `_write_create_event`; protect all runtime strings, fixtures, assertions, regexes, prompts, and subprocess arguments. There are no directive-bearing lines or shebangs in these 18 immutable blobs.

Preserve parity selection/polarity and provider payload/tool symmetry; provider qualification; push retry/recovery/state semantics; Pydantic finalization accounting; raw-git lint rules; read/store-usability and audit-index behavior; and debug-step ordering.

Pytest collects every module. `scripts/check_raw_git_writes.py` consumes the raw-git test path; `tests/unit/test_runner_hardening.py` is the runner companion; source/docs cite provider qualification, push state, store usability, and strict-push behavior. No selected value is read through `__doc__`, `inspect.getdoc`, doctest, or pydoc.

## Independent review receipt
A non-author reviewer posts exactly 58 leaf-linked TSV PASS rows: `stable_block_id<TAB>before_citation<TAB>final_citation<TAB>preserved_contract_or_consumer<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>before_words<TAB>after_words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer_session`.

Before cites the frozen SHA; final cites its full SHA. Require `0 < after_words < before_words` and three PASS fields. Missing, duplicate, extra, author-reviewed, or non-PASS rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Exactly 58 allowlisted blocks are nonempty and shorter; no unlisted prose or executable/runtime material changes.
- [ ] Frozen/current prose identity, current/final normalized AST equality, protected comments, directives, and shebangs pass on all 18 paths.
- [ ] The one leaf commit changes exactly the 18 ordered file-impact paths and has a clean scoped diff.
- [ ] Owned tests, named executable consumers, comment hygiene, and untimed worktree-venv `make verify` pass.
- [ ] The independent TSV contains exactly 58 fully cited PASS rows from a non-author reviewer.
